title: [Amazon Business] DATO DDR5 SODIMM 32GB Kit 16GBx2 5600MHz $588.99 Delivered @ DATOTEK Amazon AU
body:
Deal: [Amazon Business] DATO DDR5 SODIMM 32GB Kit 16GBx2 5600MHz $588.99 Delivered @ DATOTEK Amazon AU

[DisasterArea] Also found a corsair vengeance (micron?) kit for $594 : https://amzn.asia/d/0elkDmgO
[harukane] Just clicked the link and realized I bought this on October 29, 2025. Clicked the order details, checked my order history, and I only paid $179.33 back then…
What a time to be alive :/
[Yowie1212] I was curious after your post… 64 gb (2*32gb) corsair sodimm ram 5600mhz… July 10 2025…$228
I honestly didn't realise just how bad it had gotten…
[cnut] All so my boss doesn’t have to use their brain to reply to my emails and can laugh at fake animal videos doing stupid shit. It’s all so wonderful.
[MajoraMiasmaGold] I never heard of those new RAM manufacturers
[Ryven] Probably because the ones you have heard of sold out the domestic customer base.
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] I often see this opinion, which is weird when most likely you are into computers and know all about them.
I'm not a gamer or PCer but I know DATO as Taiwan manufacturer brand. yes the country which is one of the leading memory manufacturer in asia. can't believe you never heard of it.
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] ok but you are aware of america's "Crucial" at least from media about datacentre ai right? they make memories for many other brands of different name.
it's basically like the crucial of taiwan. Dato is their consumer brand.
[djmm] @skibidigrimacmoggr67: Yes Crucial I know
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] wow can't believe.. 32GB of ram costs $600 now??
maybe soon eventually same with 32GB microsd cards.. which data centres don't use btw. 😂
[DisasterArea] They don't use DDR5 either, but Crucial has ceased to exist (Micron decided making HBM for datacentres was more profitable) ,.. Lets see…should I buy AI from datacentres or run my own? It feels deliberate at this point.
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] afaik it's just other brand and company taking advantage of the "memory price rise" and increasing profit for unreleated memories alltogether.
also I notice WFH type product related to computers, also gone up like crazy. a few months ago I was looking my amazon purchase history, and remembered my aluminum monitor stand. I still use it made of thick aluminum one piece and I bought it fro $32 (~$35.99 with coupon) during covid I think. then I looked it up the exact same brand product was $110now !!
[cnut] 100% deliberate. They want you to own nothing, including computational power, and perpetually rent and be beholden to them.
[Dyl] I bought 48GB SODIMM for $140, getting offers of $600+ on eBay lol
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] wow I didn't realise it was seriously that bad. maybe because I'm not into computers or parts.
I'm just lucky my computer hasn't broken I guess. so I don't have to think about it.
[freeb1e4me] CUSU 32GB kit (2x16) DDR5 6000mhz $300 on AliExpress
[DisasterArea] Are you sure about that? I can only find UDIMMS (full size pc memory)
Rather than a random comment, a link would help buyers!
